keys: Some gems are still hiding. You can come back for them!
en: Some gems are still hiding. You can come back for them!
ru: Некоторые камни ещё прячутся. Можно вернуться за ними!
ro: Unele pietre încă se ascund. Poți reveni după ele!

keys: Start over? All levels and gems will be forgotten.
en: Start over? All levels and gems will be forgotten.
ru: Начать сначала? Все уровни и камни забудутся.
ro: Începi de la capăt? Toate nivelurile și pietrele vor fi uitate.

keys: Almost! You need a little more.
en: Almost! You need a little more.

keys: Almost! That is a little too many.
en: Almost! That is a little too many.

keys: Start with all the stones. Cross some out. Count what is left.
en: Start with all the stones. Cross some out. Count what is left.
ru: Возьми все камни. Зачеркни лишние. Посчитай, сколько осталось.
ro: Ia toate pietrele. Taie câteva. Numără ce a rămas.

keys: How many stones are there in all?
en: How many stones are there in all?

keys: Some stones rolled away. How many are left?
en: Some stones rolled away. How many are left?
ro: Câteva pietre s-au rostogolit. Câte au rămas?

keys: How many more stones do we need?
en: How many more stones do we need?

keys: How many stones do we need to fix the bridge?
en: How many stones do we need to fix the bridge?
ru: Сколько камней нужно, чтобы починить мост?
ro: Câte pietre ne trebuie ca să reparăm podul?

keys: How much more energy fills the machine?
en: How much more energy fills the machine?

keys: We need more stones for this bridge. Look around!
en: We need more stones for this bridge. Look around!
ru: Для этого моста нужно больше камней. Поищи вокруг!
ro: Pentru podul acesta ne trebuie mai multe pietre. Uită-te în jur!

keys: Count the stones and open the gates.
en: Count the stones and open the gates.

keys: Find the missing stones and fix the bridges.
en: Find the missing stones and fix the bridges.
ru: Найди недостающие камни и почини мосты.
ro: Găsește pietrele care lipsesc și repară podurile.

keys: Add and take away to open the gates.
en: Add and take away to open the gates.
ru: Прибавляй и отнимай, чтобы открыть ворота.
ro: Adună și scade ca să deschizi porțile.

keys: Power the lift, then fix the bridge.
en: Power the lift, then fix the bridge.

keys: Welcome to the Island of Addition!
en: Welcome to the Island of Addition!
ro: Bine ai venit pe Insula Adunării!

keys: Count the stones to open the magic gates.
en: Count the stones to open the magic gates.
ru: Считай камни, чтобы открыть волшебные ворота.
ro: Numără pietrele ca să deschizi porțile magice.

keys: A D or arrows: walk. Space: jump.
en: A D or arrows: walk. Space: jump.
ru: A D или стрелки: идти. Пробел: прыжок.
ro: A D sau săgeți: mergi. Spațiu: sari.

keys: Count the stones. Open the gate!
en: Count the stones. Open the gate!

keys: Collect stones and count the empty spots.
en: Collect stones and count the empty spots.
ru: Собирай камни и считай пустые места.
ro: Adună pietre și numără locurile goale.

keys: Some gates want you to take away.
en: Some gates want you to take away.

keys: Take away means some stones go away.
en: Take away means some stones go away.
ro: A scădea înseamnă că unele pietre pleacă.

keys: Take away: count the stones that stay.
en: Take away: count the stones that stay.

keys: Take away to open the gate.
en: Take away to open the gate.

keys: Add to open the next gate.
en: Add to open the next gate.
ro: Adună ca să deschizi poarta următoare.

keys: The last gate! Add or take away?
en: The last gate! Add or take away?

keys: Fill the machine, ride up and fix the bridge.
en: Fill the machine, ride up and fix the bridge.
ru: Наполни машину, поднимись и почини мост.
ro: Umple mașina, urcă și repară podul.

keys: Machines need energy. Fill them up!
en: Machines need energy. Fill them up!
ro: Mașinile au nevoie de energie. Umple-le!

keys: Fill the machine to start the lift.
en: Fill the machine to start the lift.
ro: Umple mașina ca să pornești liftul.

keys: Fix the bridge with your stones.
en: Fix the bridge with your stones.

keys: Open the gate at the top.
en: Open the gate at the top.

keys: The Stone Guardian guards the island.
en: The Stone Guardian guards the island.

keys: When it gets tired, solve the crystal spells.
en: When it gets tired, solve the crystal spells.
ru: Когда он устанет, разгадай заклинания кристаллов.

keys: Be brave! Rocks only bump you.
en: Be brave! Rocks only bump you.

keys: Dodge the attacks. Then touch the blue crystal!
en: Dodge the attacks. Then touch the blue crystal!

keys: Dodge again. Then pull the orange crystal!
en: Dodge again. Then pull the orange crystal!
ru: Снова уворачивайся. Потом коснись оранжевого кристалла!
ro: Ferește-te iar. Apoi atinge cristalul portocaliu!

keys: Climb the stairs to the purple crystal!
en: Climb the stairs to the purple crystal!
ru: Поднимись по лестнице к фиолетовому кристаллу!

keys: Take away to start the stone stairs!
en: Take away to start the stone stairs!
ro: Scade ca să ridici scara de piatră!

keys: The last spell! Solve it to calm the Guardian.
en: The last spell! Solve it to calm the Guardian.
ru: Последнее заклинание! Реши его, чтобы успокоить Стража.
ro: Ultima vrajă! Rezolv-o ca să liniștești Paznicul.

keys: The Guardian is tired. Find the glowing crystal!
en: The Guardian is tired. Find the glowing crystal!
ro: Paznicul a obosit. Găsește cristalul care strălucește!

keys: Stone stairs! Climb up to the Guardian.
en: Stone stairs! Climb up to the Guardian.
ro: Scară de piatră! Urcă la Paznic.

keys: The Stone Guardian is calm again. Thank you!
en: The Stone Guardian is calm again. Thank you!
ro: Paznicul de Piatră e iar liniștit. Mulțumim!

keys: Count the same-size piles to open the gates.
en: Count the same-size piles to open the gates.
ru: Считай одинаковые кучки, чтобы открыть ворота.
ro: Numără grămezile la fel de mari ca să deschizi porțile.

keys: Light the crystals and build the steps.
en: Light the crystals and build the steps.

keys: Use all your magic to reach the summit.
en: Use all your magic to reach the summit.
ru: Используй всю свою магию, чтобы добраться до вершины.
ro: Folosește toată magia ta ca să ajungi pe vârf.

keys: Every pile has the same number of stones. How many in all?
en: Every pile has the same number of stones. How many in all?
ru: В каждой кучке одинаково камней. Сколько всего?
ro: Fiecare grămadă are la fel de multe pietre. Câte sunt în total?

keys: Every step needs the same number of crystals. How many crystals in all?
en: Every step needs the same number of crystals. How many crystals in all?
ru: Каждой ступени нужно одинаково кристаллов. Сколько всего кристаллов?
ro: Fiecare treaptă are nevoie de la fel de multe cristale. Câte cristale în total?

keys: Some steps have no crystals yet. We need more.
en: Some steps have no crystals yet. We need more.
ru: На некоторых ступенях ещё нет кристаллов. Нужно больше.
ro: Unele trepte nu au încă cristale. Avem nevoie de mai multe.

keys: Crystals are left over. That is too many.
en: Crystals are left over. That is too many.
ru: Остались лишние кристаллы. Это слишком много.
ro: Au rămas cristale în plus. Sunt prea multe.

keys: Every group has the same number. Count on, group by group.
en: Every group has the same number. Count on, group by group.
ru: В каждой группе одинаково. Считай дальше, группа за группой.
ro: Fiecare grup are la fel. Numără mai departe, grup cu grup.
Bine ai venit în Munții Înmulțirii!

keys: Same-size piles are quick to count.
en: Same-size piles are quick to count.
ro: Grămezile la fel de mari se numără repede.

keys: Count one pile, then count on.
en: Count one pile, then count on.
ru: Посчитай одну кучку, потом считай дальше.
ro: Numără o grămadă, apoi numără mai departe.

keys: Count the piles. Open the gate!
en: Count the piles. Open the gate!

keys: The last gate: think in groups!
en: The last gate: think in groups!

keys: The cliffs are too tall to jump.
en: The cliffs are too tall to jump.
ro: Stâncile sunt prea înalte pentru sărit.

keys: Light the crystals to build the steps.
en: Light the crystals to build the steps.
ro: Aprinde cristalele ca să construiești treptele.

keys: Each step needs the same number of crystals.
en: Each step needs the same number of crystals.
ro: Fiecare treaptă are nevoie de la fel de multe cristale.

keys: Open the gate on the ledge.
en: Open the gate on the ledge.

keys: Build the steps to the top.
en: Build the steps to the top.

keys: Adding, taking away and groups: you know them all!
en: Adding, taking away and groups: you know them all!
ru: Сложение, вычитание и группы: ты всё знаешь!
ro: Adunarea, scăderea și grupurile: le știi pe toate!
